execution_context: Scala2.12 with Spark3.5.1 and Java17. The full historical scaffold provides sc and sparkContext. The explicit preamble binds rasterRDD: RasterRDD[Array[Float]] (11Float32bands,737x628pixels) and featuresRDD: RDD[IFeature] (2polygonfeatures). Use the supplied local fixtures or tiny in-memory values. Assertions must precede the __CHECK__ witness. HDF4 fixture layer is LST_Day_1km. Temporary writes belong in output_dir.
exec_hints: Spark specifics: transformations are lazy, so if the result is an RDD / RasterRDD / DataFrame you MUST force it with an action — .count(), .first(), or .take(1) — and print that. For an in-memory Array/value, print its size. If the API is a writer, call .coalesce(1) before writing to output_dir to avoid the distributed-write merge error. I/O: read inputs with the high-level library readers on the pre-loaded typed vars (rasterRDD / featuresRDD, or sc.geoTiff / sc.shapefile) — do NOT open raw Hadoop FileSystem streams (FileSystem.get(conf) causes 'Wrong FS'; if unavoidable use path.getFileSystem(sc.hadoopConfiguration)), and never prepend an extra 'file://' to a path that already has a scheme.
